data.name: Anoushka
data.gender_notes: Anoushka is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: An answer to a prayer, a boon, a grace given by the gods. The name Anoushka carries the meaning “Answer to prayer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Anoushka usually hope their child will grow to embody answer to prayer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a child who is believed to be an answer to a prayer, a boon, a grace given by the gods.
data.etymology: Anoushka belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Answer to prayer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anoushka total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
